answer: Octopuses have a remarkable ability called "camouflage," which allows them to change their color and texture to blend in with their surroundings. They can even mimic other animals to avoid predators or sneak up on prey. But what really makes this ability special is that they do it without any bones or scales—and they can actually change color in just seconds. So the next time you see an octopus, you're looking at a living chameleon that's both clever and fast!
